name: JayPegs Automart
rootCause: A blue-chip rekt by a front-end attack. Remind us, which part of crypto is supposed to be “trustless”? Misplaced faith (temporarily) cost MISO $3.1 million.

descriptions.text: A blue-chip rekt by a front-end attack. Remind us, which part of crypto is supposed to be “trustless”? Misplaced faith (temporarily) cost MISO $3.1 million.

JayPegs Automart's token auction on SushiSwap MISO was compromised by a malicious front-end code injection. The attacker replaced the intended beneficiary address with their own and diverted 865 ETH (~$3.1M) before funds were recovered following public exposure and negotiation. A trusted contractor inserted their own wallet address as the beneficiary in the MISO auction front-end, bypassing code review and branch protection. The injected address redirected auction proceeds to the attacker, exploiting a supply chain/insider vulnerability.
